name: StoreGauge AI for WooCommerce
author: StoreGauge AI

sections.description:
StoreGauge AI for WooCommerce adds a private AI assistant to your WordPress dashboard. Ask questions like “How did sales trend last week?”, “Which products are running low?” or “Who are my best customers?” — and get answers from your live store data, with automatic charts, quick prompt chips and a short daily briefing on issues that deserve attention.

Bring your own key: connect Google Gemini, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible provider — including a custom endpoint like GMI Cloud or your own local server. Your API key and your store data travel directly from your server to the provider you choose: no middleman service, no data passing through us.

Safe by design: the assistant is read-only — it can analyze revenue, orders, stock, customers, coupons and reviews, but it can never modify anything. Customer emails are masked, every AI access is written to an audit log, and everything is OFF until you enable it.

Also included: read-only store abilities for the WordPress 7.1 Abilities API, so external AI assistants (via an MCP adapter) can query the same data — with the same masking and audit trail.

StoreGauge AI connects your WooCommerce store to the AI assistant of your choice — safely.

  • AI chat sidebar in wp-admin — ask about your shop in plain language. Answers stream in live, and the AI calls the read-only store tools itself with its own arguments: “compare last 7 days vs last 30 days” just works. Pick the model per chat from a dropdown with capability badges (Vision, Tools, context size), attach a product photo or a text file, and every conversation is stored in your own database. Uses YOUR API key with any OpenAI-compatible provider (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral, Ollama, LM Studio…). Your key and your data never pass through us.
  • Read-only store abilities for the WordPress Abilities API / official MCP adapter: revenue summaries, recent orders, low-stock products, top sellers, product prices with unit costs (so the AI can reason about pricing and margins). Every ability is OFF by default and re-checks permissions on every single call.
  • Local audit log — every AI-visible action is recorded in your own database, with customer contact details masked and automatic pruning after 30 days (filterable).

External services

This plugin contacts one external service: the AI provider you choose and configure in the settings. Nothing is sent anywhere until you enable a feature and paste your own API key.

When you use the chat sidebar (or connect an MCP client), your own server sends requests directly to the provider base URL you configured, for example:

  • Google Gemini (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai) — Terms of Service, Privacy Policy
  • OpenAI (https://api.openai.com/v1) — Terms of Use, Privacy Policy
  • OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1) — Terms of Service, Privacy Policy

What is sent with each chat request:

  • Your chat message and the recent conversation history (last 10 messages). If you attach a product photo or a text file, that attachment is included too — the AI provider needs it to answer.
  • The results of read-only store tools the AI requests: revenue summaries, order lists (customer contact details masked), low-stock products, top sellers, product prices and costs. This data is included in the request so the provider’s AI model can answer.
  • Your API key, as an authorization header, sent only to the base URL you configured.

The plugin author receives nothing: no telemetry, no analytics, no proxy server. The API key is stored in your own site’s database and never leaves your server except to call the provider you configured.

Privacy

Store data goes directly from your server to the AI provider YOU configure. The plugin author receives nothing.

Roadmap

  • One-click Claude Desktop connect via the official MCP adapter (STDIO config)
  • Pro: weekly AI reports, restock lists, bulk product content, cart-recovery drafts — with dry-run + human approval on every write
sections.installation:
1. Install WooCommerce and WordPress 6.9+.
  2. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  3. Go to Settings → StoreGauge AI, enable what you need, and paste your AI provider API key.
sections.faq:
Who pays for the AI usage?

You do — directly to the provider you choose (Google, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq…). Free tiers work fine. The plugin author never sees your key or your data.

Can the AI change my store?

No. StoreGauge AI is read-only by design. Every ability only describes data, and everything is logged locally.

Where is the audit log?

Settings → StoreGauge AI shows the most recent audit events. Entries are stored as private records in your own database and pruned automatically after 30 days. Developers can change retention with the storegauge_audit_retention_days filter (set it to 0 to disable pruning).

Where are my conversations stored?

In your own site’s database — never on our servers and never in the cloud. Each wp-admin user sees their own conversation; it is trimmed to the last 50 messages and pruned after 30 days. The “＋” button in the chat starts a fresh one.

Can it read images?

Yes, when the selected model supports vision (look for the Vision badge in the model dropdown). Attach a product photo and ask for a description or alt text; plain-text files (.txt, .csv, .md, .json) are also supported.
sections.changelog:
0.6.1

  • New: margin insights — a 12th read-only ability computes per-product profit margins from recorded unit costs (COGS), with honest counts of products missing cost data and guidance to enable it.

0.6.0

  • Renamed the plugin to StoreGauge AI for WooCommerce.

0.5.6

  • Fix: attaching an unsupported file now shows a clear message about allowed file types instead of the generic API-key error.

0.5.5

  • Fixed: math formulas sent by the AI now render as plain readable text instead of raw LaTeX code, and the assistant is instructed to avoid LaTeX markup altogether

0.5.4

  • Fixed: text domain now matches the plugin slug and all database queries use identifier placeholders (full WordPress.org Plugin Check compliance)
  • Improved: clearer settings screen — the MCP/API toggle now explains that an external MCP adapter plugin connects AI assistants, and every access is audit-logged; the chat toggle explains where conversations live
  • Improved: consistent button and input heights across the provider cards, and card action buttons optically aligned with the provider subtitle
  • Improved: the “Load models from provider” button now has a tooltip explaining it re-fetches the current list (run it again when a provider adds models)

0.5.3

  • Fixed: removing a model in the settings now immediately removes it from the chat model picker (the picker re-fetches instead of using a page-old list)
  • Fixed: if your saved chat model is removed from its provider, the assistant falls back to another model of the same provider instead of silently using the removed one
  • Fixed: asking the AI to reveal a customer now gets a polite privacy explanation together with the masked data, instead of a bare refusal
  • Fixed: monetary amounts always follow the store currency set in WooCommerce (verified with EUR and USD)

0.5.2

  • Fixed: the quick prompt chips are no longer cut off by their own scrollbar or squeezed on short screens
  • Fixed: wide tables and long date ranges no longer create a horizontal scrollbar that covers the last chat lines — tables wrap to fit and long ranges shrink the chart bars

0.5.1

  • Fixed: the coupon usage ability silently reported “no coupons” on WooCommerce 11, where an API it relied on was removed — coupons are now listed correctly with their discount type and usage count
  • Fixed: charts now survive a page reload — the daily-sales series is stored with the message and redrawn on restore, for every provider and model
  • Fixed: replies now reliably follow the language you write in, even for small free models that previously drifted mid-conversation
  • Improved: conversation memory is now safe for every model — earlier assistant replies no longer re-enter the AI context (weak models copied stale numbers from them or drifted into another language); your questions stay in context and the assistant re-fetches live data for follow-ups
  • Improved: clearer custom-provider form examples (GMI Cloud endpoint) and a generic “Model name” hint, since model ids differ per provider
  • Improved: new server icon for custom providers (Lucide, ISC)

0.5.0

  • New: 7 more read-only abilities — daily sales series (with automatic charts in the chat), top customers (masked), coupon usage, refund rate, review summaries, sales by category, inventory value. The assistant now answers trends, customers, coupons, refunds and inventory questions from real data
  • New: quick prompt chips above the input — one tap for revenue, sales trend, low stock, top sellers and pricing analysis
  • New: proactive daily briefing — a badge on the chat bubble shows deterministic findings (stuck orders, stock running out, revenue drops, refund spikes), each with a one-tap follow-up question; findings are computed locally from your database, never invented by the AI
  • Improved: the assistant is now explicitly instructed never to invent or estimate numbers — when data is missing it says exactly what it cannot see

0.4.2

  • Improved: chat footer alignment — paperclip, input text and send arrow are now properly centered

0.4.1

  • Improved: full visual redesign of the chat panel — purple brand header, restyled bubbles, model dropdown, badges, attachment chips with file size, and message timestamps

0.4.0

  • New: multiple AI providers side by side — connect Google Gemini, OpenRouter and any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, each with its own API key
  • New: per-provider model lists — load the catalog automatically, remove models you don’t want, or add models by hand
  • New: the chat model dropdown groups models under each connected provider
  • Improved: providers that disconnect and models the provider can’t run are remembered and hidden
  • Improved: existing single-provider setups migrate automatically

0.3.2

  • Improved: the whole chat UI now uses one consistent inline SVG icon set (Lucide, ISC license) — send/stop, plus, paperclip, copy, close, chevron and check marks

0.3.1

  • Fixed: models selected from the dropdown now work on providers whose /models returns prefixed ids (e.g. “models/gemini-2.5-flash”)
  • Improved: answers render with smooth typewriter pacing so streaming is always visible, even with very fast models
  • Improved: model dropdown shows chat models first — non-chat models (TTS, music, robotics…) hide behind “show more”
  • Improved: settings field renamed to “Default model” with clearer description

0.3.0

  • New: streaming replies — answers appear live as the AI writes them, with a stop button
  • New: model dropdown in the chat header, with capability badges (Vision, Tools, context size) loaded from your provider’s /models endpoint — with OpenRouter, one key unlocks hundreds of models. Non-chat models (TTS, music, robotics…) are tucked behind “show more”
  • New: attachments — product photos (vision models) and text files (.txt, .csv, .md, .json)
  • New: conversations persist in your own database, per wp-admin user, with “new chat” to clear
  • New: pricing analysis — the AI can read product prices, sale prices and unit costs (COGS, when recorded) to compute margins and suggest pricing
  • Fixed: customer PII masking now also enforced in the pricing ability

0.2.2

  • New: full Markdown rendering in chat replies — headings, ordered/unordered lists, tables, links, inline code, code blocks, blockquotes, bold/italic/strikethrough; raw markers never leak into the UI
  • Housekeeping: dev-only files moved out of the release build

0.2.1

  • Security: permission-denied probes from anonymous visitors no longer write audit rows (prevents database flooding via the abilities REST endpoint)
  • Audit log is pruned automatically after 30 days (filterable via storegauge_audit_retention_days; 0 disables pruning)
  • Abilities now declare explicit MCP exposure meta for the official MCP adapter
  • wp.org submission hardening: Requires PHP lowered to 7.2, directory-standard readme with external-services disclosure

0.2.0

  • New: tool-calling chat — the AI requests store data itself with dynamic arguments (any date range 1–365 days)
  • New: retry with backoff on transient provider errors (429/500/503)
  • New: markdown rendering (bold/italic) in chat replies
  • New: replies always follow the language you write in
  • Improved: provider errors now fully logged to the audit trail

0.1.0

  • Initial release: read-only store abilities, BYOK chat sidebar, audit log.

screenshots.caption: Connect any AI provider with your own API key — OpenRouter, Google Gemini, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Ask about your store in plain language: daily sales for the last 90 days with an automatic chart and the top-performing days.
Attach a product photo and a vision model writes SEO descriptions, keywords and alt text for it.
Customer privacy is built in: emails are always masked in every answer.
A daily briefing surfaces what deserves attention — stuck orders, low stock — with one-click follow-ups.
